summary: WHISPERS: Realm of the Nine is a fantasy MMO prototype entered through the MMORPG Tools menu and character-creation flow. The Lantern March is authored as a multi-cell continent with a procedural terrain/prop layer; MMORPG Tools owns character lifecycle and presentation, while core scripts and place entities supply movement, combat, gathering and world behaviors.
places: places/main-menu-land/ - title and travel menu scene; the world.config.yaml default entry.
places/character-creation-land/ - character preview scene and creation camera/lighting setup.
places/main/ - Lantern March continent: Reach hub at origin, Windmill Farm southwest, Briarwild west, quarry east and further regions across 30 cells.
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - Reach hub, armory/training yard and Gatekeeper Elric (gatekeeper-elric, quest-npc); this is the Q002 giver location.
places/main/cells/x-1z0.scene - Briarwild: briar-wolf-den manager at (-92,-40) plus eight timber-tagged oak trees for gathering.
places/main/cells/x-2z2.scene - fen-deadwood scatter landmark at (-260,240), with radius-90 scatter of two static tree models.
places/main/config.yaml - playable-world spawn, gravity, terrain, vegetation scatter and cinematic look.
roots: world.config.yaml - defaultPlace main-menu-land; binds shared player, camera, arrival, MMORPG UI and nametag behavior.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod.json - registers MMORPG template and menu, player, interaction, quest and gameplay/creation camera behaviors.
templates/player.js#player - native player template runs humanoid-locomotion.js, scripts/player.js, then scripts/vanguard.js.
templates/camera.js#camera - native custom camera template using scripts/camera.js and engine look orientation.
places/main-menu-land/config.yaml and places/character-creation-land/config.yaml - menu and preview place roots with their atmosphere settings.
shared: mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/ - RPG data registries and modular panel renderers consumed by mod behaviors and ui.js.

mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/quest-data.js - quest registry/progress API shared by quest-giver.js, the quest tracker and scripts/quest-player.js; definitions are imported from scripts/lib/data/quests.yml.
scripts/lib/data/quests.yml - Q002 objectives/rewards and NPC/woodcutting tuning; imported by quest-data.js and scripts/quest-player.js.
scripts/lib/data/wolves.yml - Briar Wolf stats, timings, sounds and six pack spawn rows consumed by scripts/wolves.js.
scripts/gen/house.js, props.js, tree.js, rock.js, spire.js, stone-bridge.js, farm.js and windmill*.js - procedural scene geometry reused by authored instances with parameters.
scripts/grass.js, flower.js, pebble.js and grass-look.js - terrain scatter geometry/material reused by place bindings.
scripts/lib/regions.js and scripts/lib/data/{player,camera,world}.yml - shared region lookup and core movement/camera/world tuning; region UI tests also exist inline in ui-hud.js.
scripts/lib/data/vanguard.yml - Vanguard combat and training-dummy tuning consumed by scripts/vanguard.js and scripts/training-dummy.js.
notableExports: scripts/player.js - onInput, update; scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - sit, onInput, update.
scripts/vanguard.js - onInput, endAction, land; scripts/training-dummy.js - onSpawn, update, settle, standUp.
scripts/quest-player.js - onInput, update (player quest/interact and timber-chopping behavior; currently has no tree attachment/reference).
scripts/camera.js - finiteNumber, update; scripts/arrival.js - onArrive, onLeave; sim.js - cadence, tick.
scripts/terrain-reach.js - QUARRY, FOREST, CRYPT, FEN, BAY, heightAt, materialAt; scripts/lib/regions.js - REGIONS, MARCH, regionAt.
scripts/gen/tree.js, stone-bridge.js, farm.js, windmill.js and windmill-sails.js - geometry/collider exports; scripts/sails-spin.js - onSpawn.
ownership: scripts/player.js - room-local movement intent and core character velocity/footstep state; place config owns gravity.
scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - transient gait/turn state, character yaw, animation channels and seated locomotion.
scripts/camera.js and MMORPG camera behaviors - core camera rig pose/local-player hiding versus mod orbit and creation framing, respectively.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/player.js and character-select.js - RPG character/roster state, persistence, transitions and UI actions.
scripts/vanguard.js - player action/cooldown/guard state; scripts/training-dummy.js - dummy hp, down and hit-reaction state.
scripts/wolves.js - den respawnAt and spawned wolf AI/death state; scripts/lib/data/wolves.yml owns pack rows and combat tuning.

scripts/quest-player.js - if invoked, writes its player's quest/tally/inventory/gold/xp/interact state and timber-tree logsLeft/depletedUntil; mod player.js persists character data when _questSave is raised.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/ui.js and lib/ui-*.js - presentation from player/world state; places/main/config.yaml and scripts/terrain-reach.js own terrain inputs.
flows: world.config.yaml defaultPlace main-menu-land → MMORPG menu/player/character-select/main-menu-mgr behaviors → character creation and transition into main.
Character creation confirm in character-select.js → name registry check and character state/persistence; registry failure creates an active character id and continues loading.
world.config.yaml player template → humanoid-locomotion.js then player.js then vanguard.js; gait samples prior-tick movement velocity.
moveX/moveZ/jump input → scripts/player.js onInput stores room-local intent → update eases velocity, applies place gravity and emits terrain-selected footsteps.

attack/castSlot2/castSlot3 inputs → scripts/vanguard.js maps slots to strike/heavy/guard and schedules action hits from vanguard.yml → nearby live enemy state.hp is reduced and hit metadata/FX are emitted.
training-dummy.js observes changed state.lastHitAt → hit-reel/down animation; scheduled settle/standUp restores hp using vanguard.yml dummyReset.
places/main/cells/x-1z0.scene briar-wolf-den behavior → scripts/wolves.js reads wolves.yml, spawns scripts/gen/wolf.js pack entities, and updates chase/bite/death/respawn behavior.
quest definitions in scripts/lib/data/quests.yml → mod lib/quest-data.js filters by giverNpcId and calculates baseline-relative objectives → quest-giver.js and quest tracker consumers.

scripts/quest-player.js (unreferenced in the current tree) describes E-talk/accept/complete and timber-chopping handlers → player quest state/tally and timber tree depletion; _questSave is the mod player.js persistence signal.
world.config.yaml UI renderer → mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/ui.js and lib/ui-* renderers compose HUD/menu/quest/panels; nametag renders separately.

places/main/config.yaml terrain generator → scripts/terrain-reach.js heightAt/materialAt and scatter bindings; scene entities use scripts/gen geometry or model assets, windmill sails animate via scripts/sails-spin.js.
behaviorFamilies: scripts/gen/house.js, props.js, tree.js, rock.js, spire.js, stone-bridge.js, farm.js and windmill*.js - procedural geometry reused by scene instances, varied by kind/shape, dimensions, seed and transforms.
scripts/grass.js, flower.js and pebble.js - terrain scatter geometry reused by place bindings, varied by density, scale and seed; grass-look supplies material separately.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/player.js, character-select.js and main-menu-mgr.js - coordinated character/menu lifecycle behaviors registered by mod.json.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/camera.js and camera-creation.js - paired gameplay orbit and preview camera modes with creation-phase guards.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/ui-*.js - modular panel renderers composed by ui.js for HUD, menu, quest, inventory, map, character and settings.

scripts/vanguard.js and scripts/training-dummy.js with scripts/lib/data/vanguard.yml - player melee discipline and target reaction loop shared across three placed training dummies, varied by ability and per-dummy state.
scripts/wolves.js with scripts/lib/data/wolves.yml and scripts/gen/wolf.js - one den manager steps six configured Briar Wolves through shared AI/combat logic; per-row position, yaw and scale vary.
scripts/look-default.js and mods/aaa-quality-kit/look-cinema.js - alternative whole-frame post-process looks selected by place atmosphere.
probableOrphans: scripts/quest-player.js - added quest/gathering behavior with no reference or behavior attachment anywhere in the current tree.
migrationNotes: Keep core movement intent and locomotion scratch in room-local ctx.session; scripts/player.js writes velocity and place config owns gravity.
templates/player.js runs humanoid-locomotion before player.js; gait samples prior-tick movement velocity, with vanguard.js last for combat input.
Core scripts/camera.js uses engine look orientation and feetPosition + eyeHeight × effectiveScale.y; MMORPG orbit/creation cameras are a distinct path.
Vanguard and wolf tuning uses seconds, metres and hit points; Vanguard applies scheduled damage to target.state.hp, while wolves bite the MMORPG player's state.health.
Quest objectives use player.state.tally deltas from the accept-time baseline; completedQuests is written before Q002 rewards so a repeated claim cannot pay twice.
quest-data.js now keys QUEST_DATABASE by quest id with quest objects; consumers relying on the old NPC-keyed array shape must use its exported filtering API or adapt.
